# NimbleZero - firmware configuration (see docs/BOOT.md)
# Recovery: if this image does not boot, rename config-safe.txt to config.txt
# on a PC (FAT partition) for the most conservative settings + verbose console.
arm_64bit=1
kernel=Image
disable_overscan=1
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0
enable_uart=1
camera_auto_detect=0
gpu_mem=32
# No HDMI on this board: without this the firmware framebuffer becomes fb0, takes the
# console, and the SPI panel (then fb1) is never switched on.
max_framebuffers=0
# Composite (TV) output: this board has no connector for it, but the firmware switches it
# on when no HDMI screen is found at boot (video encoder clock 108 MHz).  Off: about 16 mA
# less at idle (hardware 2026-11-23: 199-200 -> 183 mA on battery, screen off).
enable_tvout=0

dtparam=i2c_arm=on
dtparam=i2s=on
dtparam=spi=on
dtparam=audio=off

# USB OTG controller (host/peripheral)
dtoverlay=dwc2

# Cardputer Zero board (production "v0.5" hardware): LCD, keyboard, audio,
# IO expander, RTC, LEDs, power-fail; battery gauge; IMU + magnetometer
dtoverlay=cardputerzero-v5-overlay
# LCD: 100 MHz SPI clock (vendor: 60, which the Pi turns into 50) and the panel's sync
# output on GPIO 5.  Both must stay BELOW the board overlay.  See docs/DISPLAY.md.
dtoverlay=nz-panel-100m
dtoverlay=nz-panel-te
dtoverlay=bq27220_v5
dtoverlay=bmi270_bmm150_overlay

# Infrared receiver / transmitter
dtoverlay=gpio-ir,gpio_pin=13,gpio_pull=up
dtoverlay=gpio-ir-tx,gpio_pin=12

# IMX219 camera (full model only; harmless on Lite)
dtoverlay=imx219
